description: Reusable configuration for a red team challenge council. Personas attempt to invalidate confident claims, probe abuse paths, and surface hidden failure modes.

out_of_scope: production environment probing without explicit approval

disclosure_rules.vulnerability_findings: Pair with redacted reproduction; defer to security-privacy-reviewer for disclosure path.
disclosure_rules.secret_exposure: Run scripts/redact-evidence.js BEFORE inclusion in any output.

expected_outputs.claim_status_updates: list of claims to mark invalidated|disputed

stop_conditions: any persona attempts an exploit payload
